ctbids-47939-5585057.description: Antique Frank M. Whiting & Company hand-chased Sterling silver teapot from the maker’s ornate #640 tea and coffee service. This substantial 3 pint piece weighs approximately 747 g and features a reeded body lavishly hand chased with flowers, scrolling foliage and finely textured detailing. Gadrooned borders, a raised pedestal foot, hinged domed lid with urn-form finial, elongated decorated spout, sculptural foliate handle mounts, and amber-colored insulating rings create an exceptionally ornate presentation. The considerable Sterling weight and extensive hand workmanship make this an impressive example of Frank M. Whiting hollowware. Clearly marked “HAND CHASED / STERLING / BY FRANK M. WHITING & COMPANY” with the Whiting trademark, 640, “3 PINT,” and 13A. Approximately 747 g. The 640 designation identifies the Whiting service/design; the separately stamped 13A should not be interpreted as a manufacture date without supporting documentation. Very good condition with surface wear and scratching consistent with age and use. No dents or dings. See photos for dimensions and additional condition details.
